faq.item1q: What is an Agent Readiness Score?
faq.item1a: The Agent Readiness Score measures how discoverable, readable and actionable your website is for AI agents and search crawlers — from 0 to 100.
faq.item2q: Do you store or share my website content?
faq.item2a: No. We process your content in memory during the crawl and delete it immediately afterwards. Reports are generated transiently and are not retained as stored data.
faq.item3q: Are the checks automated and deterministic?
faq.item3a: Yes. Each check performs a concrete, reproducible operation against a single signal — never estimates or guesses.
faq.item4q: How long does an audit take?
faq.item4a: Most audits complete in under a minute. Larger sites may take a few minutes depending on size and crawl depth.
faq.item5a: All traffic is TLS-encrypted end to end. Credentials are never stored in plain text.
faq.item6q: Can I export or delete my data?
faq.item6a: Yes — from Settings you can export a copy of your workspace data or delete your account at any time.
faq.item7a: Yes. Switch to dark mode in Settings Appearance at any time.
faq.item8q: What is the difference between the scan levels?
faq.item8a: QUICK scans a few key pages for a fast first look. STANDARD balances depth and speed. DEEP SCAN maximizes coverage for larger sites.
faq.item9a: Yes — Shopify stores are analyzed for theme structure, metafields, storefront discoverability and checkout accessibility.
faq.item10q: What happens if a site blocks crawlers?
faq.item10a: We respect robots.txt and access decisions. Results only include pages the site allows crawlers to reach.
faq.item11q: Can I cancel an audit after starting?
faq.item11a: Yes. Each audit can be cancelled while running. Cancelling stops the crawl and frees up your allocation immediately.
faq.item12a: Visit our Help center or email us at support@agent-readiness.dev. We’re happy to help.

landing.scoreText: Every score is calculated from real checks performed during the crawl — never estimated, never fabricated. Coverage and confidence are always displayed alongside.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Nineteen technical checks across eight weighted categories. Every result is evidence-backed and mapped to a real recommendation.

features.aiCrawlerText: Deep analysis of how crawlers like GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended and PerplexityBot are treated.
features.sitemapText: XML sitemaps checked for validity, freshness and coverage of your important pages.
features.schemaText: JSON-LD and microdata validated against Schema.org — the language AI agents understand.
features.semanticHtmlText: Headings, landmarks and ARIA evaluated for clean, meaningful document structure.
features.openGraphText: Social and AI sharing metadata verified across every analyzed page.
features.machineReadableText: Ensure body text and markup are extractable without JavaScript execution.
features.internalLinkingText: Navigation depth and internal link structure that agents can follow.
features.jsAccessText: Does your site degrade gracefully when JS is unavailable? We measure it.
features.performanceText: Response times, caching and payload size that keep agents from timing out.
features.urlStructureText: Clean, descriptive URLs that are trivial to parse and reason about.
features.actionabilityText: Forms, buttons and interactive elements available to automated agents.
features.securityHeadersText: HTTPS, headers and safe redirect behaviour that agents can rely on.

landing.securitySubtitle: We audit websites the safe way — with protections designed to keep your infrastructure and the websites we crawl secure.

security.ssrfText: We validate every URL and block requests to private networks, metadata endpoints and internal hosts.
security.httpsText: All crawls run over TLS. Plain HTTP targets are safely upgraded or rejected.
security.rateText: Politeness delays and concurrent-request caps protect your servers while we audit.
security.timeoutText: Hard per-request and per-audit timeouts prevent runaway crawls.
security.privateNetText: DNS rebinding and IP validation keep requests on the public internet only.
security.redirectText: Redirects are followed only to validated, same-origin-safe destinations.

howItWorksPage.heroTitle: From URL to actionable report in under a minute.
howItWorksPage.heroDescription: A safe, deterministic pipeline. Here’s exactly what happens, step by step.
howItWorksPage.enterUrlText: You provide a public website URL. Our system validates it against SSRF rules before anything else happens.
howItWorksPage.securityValidationText: DNS resolution, private-IP checks and HTTPS verification run first. Unsafe targets are rejected immediately.
howItWorksPage.crawlDiscoveryText: We read robots.txt and sitemap.xml, then discover pages within a safe, rate-limited scope.
howItWorksPage.pageAnalysisText: Every discovered page is downloaded and parsed for content, structure, metadata and interactive elements.
howItWorksPage.checksText: Each category is evaluated by deterministic checks — no guesswork, every result backed by captured evidence.
howItWorksPage.scoreCalcText: A weighted /100 Agent Readiness Score is computed with a clear grade, coverage and confidence level.
howItWorksPage.recommendationsText: Findings are grouped into prioritized, actionable recommendations with effort and impact estimates.

securityPage.heroDescription: We audit other people’s websites — so safety is our first feature. Here’s how we protect your data and the sites we crawl.
securityPage.authText: Role-based access control with OWNER, ADMIN, MEMBER and VIEWER roles.
securityPage.dataIsolationText: Every organization’s audits, websites and reports are isolated from every other.
securityPage.isolationText: Audits run in isolated environments with no access to your production infrastructure.
securityPage.ssrfText: Every target URL is validated. Requests to private networks, metadata services and internal hosts are blocked before any request is made.
securityPage.httpsText: All traffic is TLS-encrypted end to end. Plain-HTTP targets are handled safely.
securityPage.rateLimitsText: Politeness delays and hard concurrency caps keep audits gentle on target servers.
securityPage.timeoutText: Per-request and per-audit timeouts guarantee audits always terminate.
securityPage.privateIpText: DNS rebinding and private-range checks ensure crawls stay on the public internet.
securityPage.redirectText: Redirect chains are validated at every hop to prevent open-redirect abuse.
securityPage.auditLogsText: A tamper-evident log of every meaningful action across your workspace.
securityPage.questionsText: Contact our security team at security@agentreadiness.app
securityPage.timeoutsText: Per-request and per-audit timeouts guarantee audits always terminate.
